interpretations.decision: Black-box against a real serve-shared subprocess with planted canary tokens per evidence domain (A: repository a live tree and graph; B: repository b; C: the before-snapshot-only symbol of c, the same-path before of a) and deterministic per-case nonces. unauthorized = (expected deny AND outcome ok) OR (a canary domain hit outside the case's authorized domains; tokens present in the request are not counted) OR (expected deny AND a nonce-carrying case's nonce in a stderr tool_call line). Every deny class has a paired allow control that must be ok with its domains hit; an over-granted teeth policy must produce unauthorized > 0 and verdict blocked. Zero is reported as 'zero within the enumerated cases', never as no leakage

After each injected interruption and its recovery: jobs status shows the expected current generation with no running/interrupted/failed job; a fresh stdio server on the recovered namespace reports that generation id (structured graph_query status) and finds the expected tree canary but not the other tree's; jobs acquire --generation <current> exits 0; the generation id equals a twin-root control build of the same tree. A replace-by-copy farm corruption teeth case must be recorded invalid while the live store stays unchanged. GC-seam kills are untested (no CLI fault path without src)

A combination is a (client, transport, requested revision -> negotiated revision) cell that exists only when a run record exists; real hosts (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) are listed untested with reason no_real_host_run
